title: Introduce
subtitle: 本課限定語境：introduce = bring a person, idea, product, system, or topic into a situation for th
description: 本課限定語境：introduce = bring a person, idea, product, system, or topic into a situation for the first time, or make someone/something known to others · 「介紹；引入；推出；使人認識」

words.note: 可表示正式介紹某人，或把某個主題／內容呈現給觀眾。
words.example: The chair presented the guest speaker to the audience.
words.exampleZh: 主席向觀眾介紹嘉賓講者。

exercises.original: The chair introduced the guest speaker to the audience.
exercises.zh: 主席向觀眾介紹嘉賓講者。
exercises.upgrade: The chair presented the guest speaker to the audience.

options.explanation: 正式向觀眾介紹人物，是自然用法。
可能表示把某人聘請／帶進組織，不是現場介紹。
通常用於產品／設計首次公開。

exercises.original: The lecturer introduced the main ideas at the start of the session.
exercises.zh: 講師在課堂開始時介紹主要觀點。
exercises.upgrade: The lecturer presented the main ideas at the start of the session.

options.explanation: 把內容呈現給聽眾，很自然。
會帶「首次公開」意味，過強。

exercises.original: She introduced the new proposal to the committee.
exercises.zh: 她向委員會介紹新建議。
exercises.upgrade: She presented the new proposal to the committee.

options.explanation: 向委員會正式展示 proposal 很自然。
表示已開始執行，不只是介紹。
通常用於正式推出方案／產品。
也可表示提起，但不如 presented 有正式完整介紹意味。

words.note: 表示把新的制度、方法、人員、規則或資源帶進某個組織／情境。
words.example: The company brought in a new reporting system.
words.exampleZh: 公司引入了一套新的報告系統。

exercises.original: The company introduced a new reporting system.
exercises.zh: 公司引入了一套新的報告系統。
exercises.upgrade: The company brought in a new reporting system.

options.explanation: 若對外正式發布系統可用，但內部制度引入更常用 bring in。
新 system 被引入組織，是典型用法。

exercises.original: The government introduced stricter safety rules.
exercises.zh: 政府引入了更嚴格的安全規則。
exercises.upgrade: The government brought in stricter safety rules.

options.explanation: rules / regulations 很常和 bring in 搭配。
不如 bring in 適合法規。

exercises.original: The hospital introduced outside specialists to improve the service.
exercises.zh: 醫院引入外部專家以改善服務。
exercises.upgrade: The hospital brought in outside specialists to improve the service.

options.explanation: 把外部專家引入機構，是自然用法。

words.note: 表示正式推出新產品、服務、計劃或活動。
words.example: The company launched a new mobile app.
words.exampleZh: 公司推出了一個新的手機應用程式。

exercises.original: The company introduced a new mobile app last month.
exercises.zh: 公司上月推出了一個新手機應用程式。
exercises.upgrade: The company launched a new mobile app last month.

options.explanation: 產品正式推出市場，是最自然。
更像公司內部引進工具。

exercises.original: The organization introduced a new public awareness campaign.
exercises.zh: 該機構推出了一項新的公眾宣傳活動。
exercises.upgrade: The organization launched a new public awareness campaign.

options.explanation: 可用於具體政策／制度執行，但 campaign 通常用 launch。
campaign 是 launch 的典型搭配。
若只是首次公開內容可用，但不一定正式開始 campaign。

exercises.original: The bank introduced a new savings product.
exercises.zh: 銀行推出了一款新的儲蓄產品。
exercises.upgrade: The bank launched a new savings product.

options.explanation: financial product 正式推出最自然。
只是令公眾知道，未必正式推出。

words.note: 表示令某個人、想法、事實或作品開始被別人知道。
words.example: The campaign helped make the issue known to a wider audience.
words.exampleZh: 這項活動令更多人知道這個議題。

exercises.original: The campaign introduced the issue to a much wider audience.
exercises.zh: 這項活動令更多人知道這個議題。
exercises.upgrade: The campaign made the issue known to a much wider audience.

exercises.original: The exhibition introduced the artist's work to international audiences.
exercises.zh: 展覽讓國際觀眾認識這位藝術家的作品。
exercises.upgrade: The exhibition made the artist's work known to international audiences.

options.explanation: 讓更多人開始認識作品，是核心。

exercises.original: The article introduced a little-known researcher to the public.
exercises.zh: 這篇文章令公眾開始認識一位鮮為人知的研究員。
exercises.upgrade: The article made the researcher known to the public.

options.explanation: 通常用於產品／設計首次公開，形容人不自然。
由不知名變成被公眾認識。
不能直接表示使人知名。

words.note: 較正式，表示讓某人開始了解某人、某事或某個系統。
words.example: The training session acquainted staff with the new procedure.
words.exampleZh: 培訓課讓員工熟悉新程序。

exercises.original: The training introduced staff to the new procedure.
exercises.zh: 培訓讓員工熟悉新程序。
exercises.upgrade: The training acquainted staff with the new procedure.

options.explanation: 也可表示讓人接觸，但不一定深入熟悉。
acquaint someone with something 正式且精確。

exercises.original: The orientation session introduced new employees to company procedures.
exercises.zh: 迎新課讓新員工熟悉公司程序。
exercises.upgrade: The orientation session acquainted new employees with company procedures.

options.explanation: orientation 的目的就是讓新人熟悉制度。
可呈現程序，但不強調員工開始熟悉。
是推行新制度，不是讓人熟悉。

exercises.original: The guide introduced visitors to the history of the building.
exercises.zh: 導覽讓參觀者認識這座建築的歷史。
exercises.upgrade: The guide acquainted visitors with the history of the building.

options.explanation: 讓人開始了解某個主題，很合適。
可提供資訊，但句義不同。

words.note: 表示讓某人第一次或更多地接觸某種思想、文化、技能或經驗。
words.example: The program exposes students to different cultures.
words.exampleZh: 課程讓學生接觸不同文化。

exercises.original: The program introduces students to different cultures.
exercises.zh: 課程讓學生接觸不同文化。
exercises.upgrade: The program exposes students to different cultures.

options.explanation: 也很接近，但更強調開始熟悉。
讓學生接觸多種文化，是典型 exposure。
只是呈現內容，不一定有實際接觸。

exercises.original: The internship introduced her to real workplace problems.
exercises.zh: 實習讓她接觸到真實職場問題。
exercises.upgrade: The internship exposed her to real workplace problems.

options.explanation: 實際接觸真實問題，最自然。

exercises.original: The course introduces learners to several styles of writing.
exercises.zh: 課程讓學習者接觸多種寫作風格。
exercises.upgrade: The course exposes learners to several styles of writing.

options.explanation: 讓學習者接觸多樣風格，很自然。

words.meaning: 首次公開；揭幕；正式亮相
words.note: 表示某產品、設計、計劃或作品第一次正式向公眾展示。
words.example: The company unveiled its new electric vehicle.
words.exampleZh: 公司正式公開其新款電動車。

exercises.original: The company introduced its new electric vehicle at the motor show.
exercises.zh: 公司在車展上首次公開新電動車。
exercises.upgrade: The company unveiled its new electric vehicle at the motor show.

options.explanation: 若已正式上市也可，但 motor show 更像首次亮相。
首次向公眾展示產品是典型用法。

exercises.original: The museum introduced the restored painting to the public.
exercises.zh: 博物館向公眾首次公開修復後的畫作。
exercises.upgrade: The museum unveiled the restored painting to the public.

options.explanation: 也可，但較一般，不一定有首次公開意味。
restored work 首次重新公開，很自然。
不是常用名詞；通常用 unveiling。

exercises.original: The designer introduced the new collection at a special event.
exercises.zh: 設計師在特別活動上首次公開新系列。
exercises.upgrade: The designer unveiled the new collection at a special event.

options.explanation: special event + first public reveal 很自然。
不能自然表示正式公開系列。

words.note: 表示新服務、系統或政策開始向更多使用者正式推行。
words.example: The bank rolled out the new service nationwide.
words.exampleZh: 銀行在全國推出這項新服務。

exercises.original: The bank introduced the new service across the country.
exercises.zh: 銀行在全國推出這項新服務。
exercises.upgrade: The bank rolled out the new service across the country.

options.explanation: 也很自然，但通常更強調首次正式推出。
across the country 強調向大範圍逐步推行。
錯誤；過去式是 rolled out。

exercises.original: The company introduced the software to all offices in stages.
exercises.zh: 公司分階段向所有辦事處推行這套軟件。
exercises.upgrade: The company rolled out the software to all offices in stages.

options.explanation: in stages 是決定性線索。
較像第一次正式推出，不一定分階段。

exercises.original: The school introduced the new platform gradually over several months.
exercises.zh: 學校在數月內逐步推出新平台。
exercises.upgrade: The school rolled out the new platform gradually over several months.

options.explanation: 也接近，但 rollout 更直接對應 gradual deployment。
gradually over several months 是典型 rollout。

words.note: 當 introduce 表示「開始談某個議題」時可接近。
words.example: She brought up the issue during the meeting.
words.exampleZh: 她在會議中提出了這個議題。

exercises.original: She introduced the issue during the meeting.
exercises.zh: 她在會議中提出了這個議題。
exercises.upgrade: She brought up the issue during the meeting.

options.explanation: 不能用於一般討論議題。
在談話／會議中提出 topic 是典型用法。

exercises.original: He introduced a difficult question near the end of the discussion.
exercises.zh: 他在討論接近尾聲時提出了一個棘手問題。
exercises.upgrade: He brought up a difficult question near the end of the discussion.

options.explanation: 也可表示提出，但更正式。
口語討論中提出問題最自然。

exercises.original: The manager introduced the topic of workload at the meeting.
exercises.zh: 經理在會議中提出了工作量這個話題。
exercises.upgrade: The manager brought up the topic of workload at the meeting.

options.explanation: 名詞，表示養育／成長背景。

words.note: 當 introduce 表示把新的制度、政策、方法正式投入使用時可接近。
words.example: The school implemented a new assessment system.
words.exampleZh: 學校實施了一套新的評估制度。

exercises.original: The school introduced a new assessment system this year.
exercises.zh: 學校今年實施了一套新的評估制度。
exercises.upgrade: The school implemented a new assessment system this year.

options.explanation: 真正開始使用制度，是最精確。
也可能表示開始，但制度執行更常用 implement。

exercises.original: The company introduced stricter security procedures across all offices.
exercises.zh: 公司在所有辦事處實施更嚴格的保安程序。
exercises.upgrade: The company implemented stricter security procedures across all offices.

exercises.original: The organization introduced a new policy to reduce waste.
exercises.zh: 該機構實施了一項減少浪費的新政策。
exercises.upgrade: The organization implemented a new policy to reduce waste.

options.explanation: 也可表示政策正式推出，但 implementation 更強調開始執行。
若分階段推行可用，但題句沒有 gradual deployment 線索。
policy 正式投入實施，是最精確。

falseSynonyms.zh: 解釋 ≠ 介紹 explain 是把內容說清楚； introduce 可以只是讓人首次認識。
宣布 ≠ 推出／介紹 announce 只是公開說出消息，不一定真正推出產品或制度。
宣傳 ≠ 介紹 advertise 是促銷或宣傳，不等於第一次引入。
提及 ≠ 正式介紹 mention 只是簡單提到。
推薦 ≠ 介紹 recommend 表示建議別人選擇某人／某物。
呈現 ≠ 所有 introduce present 可表示展示內容，但不一定帶「首次引入」。
詞形陷阱 - introduce = 動詞 - introduction = 名詞 - introductory = 入門的；介紹性的
詞形不同 - launch = 動詞／名詞 - launching = 推出行動 - launcher = 發射器／啟動器
